name: Durer
source:
One of the jailers of the prison where Enzai takes place. He is a sadistic pervert that absolutely relishes in tormenting the prisoners, and is wicked to the core. Since he is a bureaucrat's ([url=/c10896]Bollanet[/url]'s) son, Durer can do whatever he pleases in the prison. 

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
